name: competitor-gap
title_zh: 专挖对手有而你没有的搜索词，按流量和可赢性排好序
tagline_zh: 别再猜对手凭什么排你前面。输入对方域名，直接列出你缺哪些词、每个词能带来多少流量、值不值得抢。附可赢性评分。
tagline_en: Stop guessing why they outrank you. Enter a competitor domain, get the exact keywords you're missing, ranked by.
desc_en: Find keywords a competitor ranks for that the user's site doesn't — the content gap, prioritized by volume and winnability. Use when asked "what does competitor.com rank for", "keyword gap vs X", "steal competitor keywords", or "why do they outrank us".
why_zh: 不是简单差集。它把每个缺口词按搜索量和你的现有排名综合打分，告诉你先抢哪个、哪个抢了也白抢。
why_en: Not just a keyword diff. It scores each gap by search volume and your current rank, telling you which battles to fight first.
limit_zh: 只认公开搜索数据，不覆盖 Google Ads 私有词或长尾意图；需要你已配置搜索 API 密钥。产物是候选词表。
limit_en: Uses public search data only; no private Ads terms or long-tail intent. Requires your own Search API key. Output is a keyword list, not content or.
title_en: Keyword gap vs competitor, sorted by volume & winnability
